long-covid.title: Recommendations for the primary care management of post COVID and post acute infectious syndrome: a comparative analysis of international guidelines.

General practitioners play an essential role in initial assessment and the coordination of care and treatment.

This response is a precursor to cirrhosis, hepatocellular carcinoma, and end-stage liver failure, which have a substantial global health burden and limited therapeutic options.
